root.label: One-definition rule
root.note: The program must behave as if each entity had exactly one definition.

children.label: Three layers
children.note: Per translation unit, per program, and repeated definitions that must match.

children.label: One per TU
children.note: Two definitions of anything in one translation unit are diagnosed.

children.label: One per program
children.note: Non-inline odr-used functions and variables need exactly one definition overall.

children.label: Repeatable items
children.note: Classes, enums, inline entities, templates and concepts may be defined once per TU.

children.label: Odr-use
children.note: Only odr-used entities need a definition to exist.

children.label: Reading a constant
children.note: An immediate read of a variable usable in constant expressions is not an odr-use.

children.label: References and addresses
children.note: Binding a reference or taking the address is an odr-use, as with std::min(x, S::n).

children.label: Lambda captures
children.note: A lambda may read a local constant uncaptured but must capture it to take its address.

children.label: static constexpr
children.note: Since C++17 constexpr static members are inline and need no out-of-class definition.

children.label: Same definitions
children.note: Repeated definitions must match token for token and in meaning.

children.label: Same tokens
children.note: Each definition must consist of the same sequence of tokens.

children.label: Same entities
children.note: Names must find the same entities after overload resolution in every TU.

children.label: Constant exception
children.note: Internal-linkage constants may differ per TU only if they are not odr-used.

children.label: Lambdas
children.note: Lambdas in inline functions share one closure type; namespace-scope constexpr ones do not.

children.label: How it bites
children.note: Violations are ill-formed, no diagnostic required, so nothing has to warn you.

children.label: Macros and flags
children.note: NDEBUG, -D values or #pragma pack can make one class two layouts.

children.label: Name clashes
children.note: Two libraries' inline version() or Node with different bodies in one namespace.

children.label: Varies with -O
children.note: At -O0 the linker's copy wins; at -O2 each TU may inline its own body.

children.label: Missing inline
children.note: inline in one TU but not another is ill-formed and may fail to link at -O2.

children.label: Vague linkage
children.note: Implementation practice: emit weak or COMDAT copies and keep one.

children.label: Weak symbols
children.note: Inline functions, template instantiations and guard variables; nm -m shows weak external.

children.label: Key function
children.note: Itanium ABI emits a vtable with the first non-inline, non-pure virtual function.

children.label: Detection tools
children.note: GCC -flto -Wodr catches mismatched types but not differing inline function bodies.
